# openmetadata_data_product Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata data product by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_data_product" "customer_insights" {
  fully_qualified_name = "CustomerInsights"
}

output "customer_insights_domains" {
  value = data.openmetadata_data_product.customer_insights.domains
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Data product fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Data product UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains that own the data product.
- `name` (String) Data product name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
